data.headline: AMREP Q2 revenue fell 66.1% year over year

claims.text: Q2 2026 revenue was $6.1 million, down 66.1% year over year from $17.9 million.
The filing attributes the change primarily to lower revenue from developed residential land, developed commercial land and undeveloped land.

citation.quote: The change in land sale revenues for the three months ended July 31, 2026 compared to the prior period was primarily due to a decrease in revenues from the sale of developed residential land, developed commercial land and undeveloped land.

claims.text: No developed residential or commercial acreage was sold in the three months ended July 31, 2026, versus 8.9 acres and 5,227 in revenue in the prior-year period.

Total Developed | — | — | — | 8.9 | 5,227 | 587

claims.text: Undeveloped land sales fell to 27.9 acres and 173 in revenue from 486.1 acres and 2,267.
The 10-K says future real-estate growth will require acquiring new properties in New Mexico or expanding to other markets to provide sufficient assets.

citation.quote: The continuity and future growth of the Company’s real estate business, if the Company pursues such growth, will require that the Company acquire new properties in New Mexico or expand to other markets to provide sufficient assets to support a meaningful real estate business.
